summary: Deep edge-case validation of the 5 new iteration-26 features (leaderboard, gift cards, certificates CSV, assignment retry limits, notification center). Backend: 26 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration26.py — all passed (auth/role gating, gift-card double-redeem 400, invalid code 404, disabled-card 400, leaderboard privacy + staff exclusion + sorting, CSV headers/quoting/verify_url, max_attempts=1 enforcement + 0=unlimited + negative clamp, notification feed shape/sorting/unread reset). Frontend: verified student flows (bell + unread badge lifecycle, panel items, /leaderboard me-card + row, /profile gift-card redeem with invalid + double-redeem toasts and live store-credit update), admin flows (giftcards pane create + disable, export-certificates-csv real file download 'certificates.csv', lesson editor max-attempts field appears only with requires-submission, persists and round-trips), and ProgramDetail AssignmentPanel showing '1 of 1 left' then the lockout notice after submitting. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: leaderboard_enabled kill-switch is read from app_settings but there is no admin endpoint/UI to set it, so the documented opt-out is unreachable.
Recomputes 4 full-collection aggregations + full users scan (to_list(10000)) on every request with no cache/limit-by-index; will degrade as data grows.

Read-then-write (find_one then update_one) instead of atomic find_one_and_update({code, status:'active'}). A 6-way parallel redeem probe showed only one 200 and a single credit today, but the check is not concurrency-safe by construction.
unread is computed with lexicographic string comparison of ISO timestamps; if any source stores a naive/offset-less timestamp the count can be wrong. Parse to datetime instead.
Accepts an already-redeemed card and flips status redeemed -> disabled, losing redemption audit state (no status guard).

issues: Tab pill strip overflows the max-width container at 1920px — the 'Gift Cards' / later tabs are clipped off the right edge with no visible scroll affordance; reachable only via ?tab= URL or horizontal scroll.
Item titles are single-line truncated ('New episode: The breath is the prac…'); consider 2-line clamp.
With a single ranked user the page is mostly empty whitespace; a short explainer of how points are earned would fill it.

action_items: Optional hardening: make gift-card redemption atomic (find_one_and_update with status filter) before real money is involved.
Either expose a leaderboard_enabled toggle in admin settings or drop the unreachable kill-switch branch.
Parse timestamps (not string-compare) when computing notifications unread count.
Fix admin tab strip overflow so the Gift Cards tab is reachable by click on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: giftcards.redeem_gift_card: two-step read/update is a classic double-spend shape; use db.gift_cards.find_one_and_update({'code':c,'status':'active','balance':{'$gt':0}}, {...}) and credit only if it returns a doc.
leaderboard.leaderboard: no pagination/caching on 4 aggregations + users scan; consider a periodically-materialised leaderboard collection.
notifications.list_notifications: unread uses str(at) > str(seen_at); normalise to timezone-aware datetimes.
Admin.jsx is very large (1700+ lines) — GiftCardsPane/CoursesPane/LessonsEditor should be split into separate modules per the 700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: All test artifacts cleaned up: TEST_iter26 gift cards (6) deleted, TEST_iter26 announcement deleted, TEST_iter26 lesson+video deleted via admin API, test submissions removed, seeded TESTCERT26 certificate removed, and student@demo.com store_credit restored to its pre-test value of 50.00.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md present and all 3 accounts (admin/student/instructor) authenticate successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration26.py (pytest, external URL from frontend/.env, self-cleaning). It creates and deletes its own program lesson under the first program returned by GET /api/programs, so it is safe to re-run. Assignment lockout UI was verified using the admin (staff access) view of ProgramDetail because student@demo.com is not enrolled in any program; if enrollment seed data is added, re-verify as the student. All findings are hardening/design-level — no functional defects were reproduced.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failing behaviour reproduced. The only theoretical defect (gift-card double-credit) is a read-then-write race; a 6-thread concurrent redeem returned 1x200 + 5x400 with a single 10.00 credit, so it is not currently exploitable under the single-worker async server, but the code path is not atomic.
